summary: Validated the Expo Go startup-crash remediation and security boundary requirements on public preview: cold-load reached Home without crash/fallback, no browser-console EgressViolation, privacy egress contract tests passed (locale allowed, device_name rejected), security boot fail-closed tests passed, Android Metro bundle compiled, and /api/health remained schemaVersion=1/status=ok/service=apollo-v1.

minor.issue: ModuleNotFoundError: server when PYTHONPATH is not set in this environment; test passes with PYTHONPATH=/app/backend.

action_items: Optional hardening: make backend pytest imports resilient without requiring explicit PYTHONPATH in runner env.
critical_code_review_comments: privacy.ts device_register allow-list now correctly includes locale and still rejects unknown keys, matching intended fail-closed egress behavior.
ApolloContext heartbeat boot call is now promise-contained; synchronous egress schema throws are no longer uncaught at boot.
securityBoot fail-closed proxy + SafeStartScreen preserve native-module-missing boundary for Expo Go without selecting simulated/native fallback.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview web run shows Home and a visible badge/copy indicating MOCKED DEVICE INPUT — PREVIEW ONLY. This is expected preview behavior, not an API mock injected by this test run.
rca_of_issue: Original crash path is consistent with synchronous EgressViolation during boot heartbeat payload validation (deviceMeta locale not allow-listed + throw escaped old catch). Current tests indicate locale now accepted and boot flow no longer surfaces uncaught startup error.
